Do you keep track even when many threads come together? Then you are exactly right with us. With your organizational talent and your customer orientation, you ensure that our customer orders are processed smoothly and on time.

What will you do

• You ensure that our customer orders are processed smoothly and on time from incoming orders to delivery.

• You are the central contact person for our customers and sales companies and find competent solutions for orders, delivery dates and logistics.

• Together with production, purchasing and logistics You ensure that materials are available and our delivery commitments are met.

• You also keep track of challenging situations, communicate proactively in the event of scheduling deviations and coordinate suitable solutions.

• You handle complaints, returns and credits and contribute to a high customer satisfaction.

• You maintain master data in the SAP/ERP system and ensure high data quality.

• You analyze key figures such as delivery deadlines and quality and identify potential for improvement.

• You bring your ideas and actively shape the further development of our processes.

Who you are

• You have a completed commercial or technical training – ideally supplemented by a corresponding further education.

• You bring several years of experience in order processing, customer service or supply chain management of a manufacturing company.

• You work securely with SAP (especially in order processing and master data management) as well as with the MS Office applications.

• You communicate stylishly in German and well in English – experience in an international environment is a plus.

• You think analytically, have a good feeling for key figures and are interested in efficient processes.

• You convince with a high customer orientation, a clear communication and self-initiative.

• You work in a structured, independent and solution-oriented manner and keep an overview even in a dynamic environment.

Who we are

At Belimo, we are proud to make our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and promote new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees not only create amazing products, but also revolutionize the HVAC industry. Investing in our employees is at the heart of Belimo when it comes to engaging diverse creative talents to build an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the competence and commitment of each individual.

As a production engineer, you take responsibility for our end-of-line test facilities and thus make a decisive contribution to product quality and process stability in series production. You will work closely with our internal teams and external partners to implement practical and effective solutions.

If you want to develop and implement innovative solutions for the continuous improvement of our test and process landscapes, apply now!

What will you do

• You ensure the availability, stability and performance of our end-of-line test systems and contribute directly to product quality.

• You industrialize and commission new test facilities - from calibration and verification to stable delivery to series production.

• You optimize existing plants as well as test and production processes from planning to implementation, including process, product and software changes.

• You systematically analyze disturbances and deviations, remedy them sustainably and derive targeted improvement measures.

• You coordinate yourself internally with our maintenance, quality and engineering departments.

•
You actively contribute to improving the evaluation and use of test data and support the transfer of knowledge.

Who you are

• Technical degree or technical training in electronics, mechanics
or comparable

• Several years of experience in a similar role in a company with a high production volume

• Experience in optimizing production or testing processes, ideally with Lean or Six Sigma methods

• Practical experience in the further development of production plants - from the analysis of plant behavior to the definition of changes to the verification and approval for the series

• Structured and independent working method, interdisciplinary thinking and affinity for metrology

• Knowledge of Python and SQL for statistical data analysis

• Flowing German and English skills in word and writing as well as willingness to travel (about 5%)

Who we are

At Belimo, we are proud to make our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and promote new ideas in their teams around the world. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes internes et nos partenaires externes pour mettre en œuvre des solutions pratiques et efficaces.

• Vous analysez systématiquement les perturbations et les déviations, vous les corrigez de façon durable et vous obtenez des mesures d'amélioration ciblées.

• Vous vous coordonnez en interne avec nos services de maintenance, de qualité et d'ingénierie.

•
Vous contribuez activement à l'amélioration de l'évaluation et de l'utilisation des données d'essai et soutenez le transfert des connaissances.

Qui vous êtes

• Diplôme technique ou formation technique en électronique, mécanique
ou comparables

• Plusieurs années d'expérience dans un rôle similaire dans une entreprise avec un volume de production élevé

• Expérience dans l'optimisation des processus de production ou de test, idéalement avec les méthodes Lean ou Six Sigma

• Expérience pratique dans le développement ultérieur des usines de production - de l'analyse du comportement de la plante à la définition des changements à la vérification et l'approbation pour la série

• Méthode de travail structurée et indépendante, réflexion interdisciplinaire et affinité pour la métrologie

• Connaissance de Python et SQL pour l'analyse des données statistiques

• Exploiter les compétences en allemand et en anglais dans l'écriture et la parole ainsi que la volonté de voyager (environ 5%)

Qui nous sommes

Chez Belimo, nous sommes fiers de faire de notre entreprise un lieu de travail enrichissant. Grâce à notre passion, nos employés non seulement créent des produits étonnants, mais révolutionnent également l'industrie du CVC. Investir dans nos employés est au cœur de Belimo quand il s'agit de mobiliser divers talents créatifs pour construire une entreprise leader de l'industrie. Le succès de notre marque est basé sur la compétence et l'engagement de chaque individu.

 formazione commerciale o tecnica di base; Ulteriori studi o studi in marketing/comunicazione sono vantaggiosi

descriptionByLocale.en:
In this role, you are part of the EMEA marketing team within the Marketing Communications department and support our national subsidiaries with effective sales enablement.

You are responsible for the conception and implementation of events as well as trade fair appearances and make a significant contribution to the tangible and successful marketing of our products and services.

What will you do

•
 Design, planning, implementation and follow-up of trade fairs and events in the EMEA region

•
 Development of integrated trade fair concepts (storyline, embassies, visual language, visitor guidance) to support sales

•
 Overall responsibility for project and budget planning including administrative handling

•
 Control and coordination of external service providers and trade fair organisers

•
 Organization and provision of all relevant marketing materials (advertising, PR, exhibits, give-aways)

•
 Responsibility for the smooth installation and dismantling as well as the implementation of trade fair and event appearances

•
 Success measurement including derivation of optimization measures as well as ensuring the corporate design guidelines

•
 Sparring partners for international stakeholders and support for other marketing projects (e.g. product launches, sales initiatives)

Who you are

•
 basic commercial or technical training; Further education or studies in marketing/communication are advantageous

•
 Several years of experience in event, trade fair or project management, ideally in the B2B environment

•
 Flowing knowledge of German and English in words and writing

•
 Strong organisational and project management skills as well as experience in managing diverse stakeholders

•
 Ability for lateral guidance, high level of initiative and pragmatic and solution-oriented working methods

•
 Strong conceptual thinking with a sense for brand staging, visitor guidance and integrated communication

•
 Technical affinity with an understanding of products in need of explanation; Experience in HVAC/building technology is an advantage

 High flexibility, willingness to travel (about 20%, sometimes on weekends) and category B driving licence desirable

Who we are

At Belimo, we are proud to make our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and promote new ideas in their teams around the world. Investing in our employees is at the heart of Belimo when it comes to engaging diverse creative talents to build an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the competence and commitment of each individual.
